Visual description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post attributed to Senator Mark Kelly. His profile picture appears as a small circular headshot in the top left. The post text criticizes the President and Pete Hegseth for not being committed to security in Europe and says their actions make the country less safe and embolden Vladimir Putin, claiming they cower to Russia. Below this post is an embedded screenshot of a Politico article. The Politico header is visible along with navigation links, and the article headline discusses Pentagon officials being surprised by a decision by Hegseth regarding troops in Poland, followed by a brief subheading explaining uncertainty about the Defense secretary’s order not to send troops on a routine mission to an allied country.
